title: File:March Dawn in North Dakota by Victoria Lee Croasdell.jpg
author: Victoria.Lee.Croasdell
description: This unenhanced, original image of the dawn sky at 6:16 am on 3/30/2017 denotes the visual variances in the rising sky’s appearance dependent on atmospheric conditions, like humidity, temperature and degree of cloud cover. I regularly photograph the rising and setting sun throughout the year, notating the recurrent visual changes. This was taken with a Nikon D3300 130mm, on MRISAR grounds in New Leipzig, North Dakota. I am an awarded, published and exhibited; Multi-disciplined Artist, Photographer, Poet, Writer Scientist, Inventor, Machinist and Engineer. My favorite activity is photographing sunrises, sunsets, waterscapes and landscapes. I am a founding member of the internationally renowned, MRISAR R&D Family Team. Examples of my original art and photography, as well as my team’s technologies can be seen at mrisar.org.
